content: The discursive analysis of a document normally includes three consecutive steps: 1) discursive segmentation; 2) detection of the discursive relations; 3) construction of the hierarchical rhetorical tree. Regarding the discursive segmentation, there are segmenters in several languages. However, each piece depends on sofisticated linguistic resources, which complicates the reproduction of the experiments in other languages. Consequently, the development of multilingual systems using discursive analysis are yet to be developed. Diverse applications based on the latest technologies require at least one of the three steps mentioned above BIBREF1, BIBREF2, BIBREF3. In this context, the idea of exploring the architecture of a generic system that is able not only of segmenting a text correctly but also of adapting it to any language, was a great motivation of this research work.
